name: improve
description: Use when a repository candidate needs a deliberate review-and-improvement loop: use recent Git history, make warranted changes, run meaningful checks, and require two consecutive trivial-only review passes. Supports a read-only interpretation preview; not a one-off code review.

interface.shortDescription: Review, test and improve with explicit stopping rules
interface.longDescription: Release-candidate repository improvement workflow with preview, seven-message history, scoped local commits, evidence capture, and a bundled Until Loop runtime. Publishing source does not prove execution on every host.
defaultPrompt: Dry-run $improve on these changes without writing files.
Use $improve on these changes, preserving unrelated work.
